                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 3/24/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Maldonado (26)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 3-1 at 1237 N California Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                     Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards




                                              ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is

hereby amended by changing all of the M1-1 Limited Manufacturing District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 3-1 in the area bounded by:

           A line 89.33 feet north of and parallel to West Crystal Street; the public alley next
           east of and parallel to North California Avenue; West Crystal Street; North
           California Avenue,

to those of a B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.




                                                 Roberto Maldonado
                                                 Alderman, 26''' Ward




Common Address:                   1237 N. California Avenue
